package store

import (
	"context"

type fakeRows struct {
	pgx.Rows
	n, i     int
	failAt   int
	endError error
	closed   bool
	data     [][]any
}

func (r *fakeRows) Next() bool { r.i++; return r.i <= r.n }
func (r *fakeRows) Scan(dest ...any) error {
	if r.i == r.failAt {
		return errors.New("scan failed")
	}
	if len(dest) == 1 {
		return dest[0].(*SelfReferencing).Scan(int64(r.i))
	}
	if r.data != nil {
		for index, value := range r.data[(r.i-1)%len(r.data)] {
			field := reflect.ValueOf(dest[index]).Elem()
			if value == nil {
				field.SetZero()
				continue
			}
			if field.Kind() == reflect.Pointer {
				field.Set(reflect.New(field.Type().Elem()))
				field = field.Elem()
			}
			source := reflect.ValueOf(value)
			if source.Type() != field.Type() {
				source = source.Convert(field.Type())
			}
			field.Set(source)
		}
		return nil
	}
	*(dest[0].(*int64)) = int64(r.i)
	*(dest[1].(*string)) = "Alice"
	*(dest[2].(*int32)) = 42
	return nil
}
func (r *fakeRows) Close()     { r.closed = true }
func (r *fakeRows) Err() error { return r.endError }

type fakeDB struct {
	DBTX
	rows   fakeRows
	copied [][]any
	batch  *pgx.Batch
}

func (d *fakeDB) Query(context.Context, string, ...any) (pgx.Rows, error) {
	d.rows.i = 0
	d.rows.closed = false
	return &d.rows, nil
}
func (d *fakeDB) QueryRow(context.Context, string, ...any) pgx.Row { d.rows.i = 1; return &d.rows }
func (d *fakeDB) Exec(context.Context, string, ...any) (pgconn.CommandTag, error) {
	return pgconn.CommandTag{}, nil
}

var resultSink []ListUsersRow
var oneSink GetUserRow
var intSink int64
var sqlSink string
var argsSink []any

func BenchmarkRows(b *testing.B) {
	ctx := context.Background()
	db := &fakeDB{}
	q := New(db)
	for _, n := range []int{0, 1, 100, 1000} {
		db.rows.n = n
		for _, test := range []struct {
			name string
			run  func(context.Context) ([]ListUsersRow, error)
		}{{"Generated", q.ListUsers}} {
			b.Run(fmt.Sprintf("%s/N%d", test.name, n), func(b *testing.B) {
				b.ReportAllocs()
				for b.Loop() {
					var err error
					resultSink, err = test.run(ctx)
					if err != nil {
						b.Fatal(err)
					}
				}
			})
		}
		b.Run(fmt.Sprintf("Stream/N%d", n), func(b *testing.B) {
			b.ReportAllocs()
			for b.Loop() {
				var sum int64
				for row, err := range q.StreamUsers(ctx) {
					if err != nil {
						b.Fatal(err)
					}
					sum += row.ID
				}
				intSink = sum
			}
		})
	}
	b.Run("One", func(b *testing.B) {
		b.ReportAllocs()
		for b.Loop() {
			var err error
			oneSink, err = q.GetUser(ctx, 1000)
			if err != nil {
				b.Fatal(err)
			}
		}
	})
	b.Run("Exec", func(b *testing.B) {
		b.ReportAllocs()
		for b.Loop() {
			if err := q.DeleteUser(ctx, 1000); err != nil {
				b.Fatal(err)
			}
		}
	})
}
func BenchmarkBuilder(b *testing.B) {
	q := New(&fakeDB{})
	for _, test := range []struct {
		name string
		make func() *SearchUsersBuilder
	}{
		{"Empty", func() *SearchUsersBuilder { return q.SearchUsers() }},
		{"OneWhere", func() *SearchUsersBuilder { return q.SearchUsers().Where("id", "=", int64(1000)) }},
		{"WhereOrderPage", func() *SearchUsersBuilder {
			return q.SearchUsers().Where("age", ">", int32(25)).OrderBy("name", "ASC").Limit(20).Offset(40)
		}},
		{"In100", func() *SearchUsersBuilder { return q.SearchUsers().Where("id", "IN", ids) }},
	} {
		b.Run(test.name, func(b *testing.B) {
			b.ReportAllocs()
			for b.Loop() {
				var err error
				sqlSink, argsSink, err = test.make().buildQuery()
				if err != nil {
					b.Fatal(err)
				}
			}
		})
	}
	b.Run("ResolveColumn", func(b *testing.B) {
		b.ReportAllocs()
		for b.Loop() {
			var ok bool
			sqlSink, ok = sglResolveColumn("id", searchUsersAllowedColumns)
			if !ok {
				b.Fatal("no column")
			}
		}
	})
	b.Run("ResolveColumnDirect", func(b *testing.B) {
		b.ReportAllocs()
		for b.Loop() {
			var ok bool
			sqlSink, ok = searchUsersAllowedColumns["id"]
			if !ok {
				b.Fatal("no column")
			}
		}
	})
}

var ids = func() []int64 {
	v := make([]int64, 100)
	for i := range v {
		v[i] = int64(i + 1000)
	}
	return v
}()

func TestRowsOwnTheirValues(t *testing.T) {
	db := &fakeDB{rows: fakeRows{n: 1000}}
	q := New(db)
	rows, err := q.ListUsers(t.Context())
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	for i, row := range rows {
		if row.ID != int64(i+1) {
			t.Fatalf("row %d changed: %+v", i, row)
		}
	}
	if !db.rows.closed {
		t.Fatal("rows not closed")
	}
	rows[0].Name = "changed"
	if rows[1].Name != "Alice" {
		t.Fatal("rows share storage")
	}
	var streamed []StreamUsersRow
	for row, err := range q.StreamUsers(t.Context()) {
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		streamed = append(streamed, row)
	}
	for i, row := range streamed {
		if row.ID != int64(i+1) {
			t.Fatal("streamed row changed")
		}
	}
	items, err := q.SearchUsers().All(t.Context())
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	for i, row := range items {
		if row.ID != int64(i+1) {
			t.Fatal("builder row changed")
		}
	}
}
func TestStreamAdvancesAfterScanErrorAndClosesEarly(t *testing.T) {
	db := &fakeDB{rows: fakeRows{n: 3, failAt: 2}}
	q := New(db)
	values, failures := 0, 0
	for row, err := range q.StreamUsers(t.Context()) {
		if err != nil {
			failures++
			if row != (StreamUsersRow{}) {
				t.Fatal("error row not zero")
			}
			continue
		}
		values++
	}
	if values != 2 || failures != 1 || !db.rows.closed {
		t.Fatalf("values=%d failures=%d closed=%v", values, failures, db.rows.closed)
	}
	for range q.StreamUsers(t.Context()) {
		break
	}
	if !db.rows.closed || db.rows.i != 1 {
		t.Fatal("early stop did not close after first row")
	}
	db.rows.failAt = 0
	db.rows.endError = errors.New("iteration failed")
	if _, err := q.ListUsers(t.Context()); !errors.Is(err, db.rows.endError) {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
}
func TestScalarAllocationBudgets(t *testing.T) {
	db := &fakeDB{}
	q := New(db)
	ctx := context.Background()
	for _, c := range []struct {
		rows  int
		limit float64
	}{{0, 0}, {1, 3}, {1000, 20}} {
		db.rows.n = c.rows
		count := testing.AllocsPerRun(20, func() {
			var err error
			resultSink, err = q.ListUsers(ctx)
			if err != nil {
				panic(err)
			}
		})
		if count > c.limit {
			t.Fatalf("%d rows: %.0f allocations, budget %.0f", c.rows, count, c.limit)
		}
		count = testing.AllocsPerRun(20, func() {
			for row, err := range q.StreamUsers(ctx) {
				if err != nil {
					panic(err)
				}
				intSink = row.ID
			}
		})
		limit := float64(2)
		if c.rows == 0 {
			limit = 0
		}
		if count > limit {
			t.Fatalf("stream %d rows: %.0f allocations, budget %.0f", c.rows, count, limit)
		}
	}
}

type SelfReferencing struct {
	Value int64
	Self  *SelfReferencing
}

func (s *SelfReferencing) Scan(value any) error { s.Value = value.(int64); s.Self = s; return nil }

func TestCustomScannerKeepsIndependentReceivers(t *testing.T) {
	db := &fakeDB{rows: fakeRows{n: 3}}
	q := New(db)
	rows, err := q.ListCustom(t.Context())
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	for index, row := range rows {
		if row.ID.Self.Value != int64(index+1) {
			t.Fatal("custom scanner reused its receiver")
		}
	}
}

func TestGroupedRowsPreserveOrderAndMissingDetails(t *testing.T) {
	db := &fakeDB{rows: fakeRows{n: 4, data: [][]any{{2, "second", 20, 21, "first detail", 1}, {1, "first", 10, 11, "another", 1}, {2, "second", 20, 22, "last detail", 2}, {3, "third", 0, nil, nil, nil}}}}
	rows, err := New(db).ListOrdersWithItems(t.Context())
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if len(rows) != 3 || rows[0].Orders.ID != 2 || rows[1].Orders.ID != 1 || rows[2].Orders.ID != 3 {
		t.Fatalf("unexpected group order: %+v", rows)
	}
	if len(rows[0].OrderItems) != 2 || *rows[0].OrderItems[0].ID != 21 || *rows[0].OrderItems[1].ID != 22 {
		t.Fatal("details lost or reordered")
	}
	if rows[2].OrderItems != nil {
		t.Fatal("missing detail was not nil")
	}
	db.rows.n = 0
	rows, err = New(db).ListOrdersWithItems(t.Context())
	if err != nil || rows == nil || len(rows) != 0 {
		t.Fatal("empty grouped result changed")
	}
}

func (db *fakeDB) CopyFrom(_ context.Context, _ pgx.Identifier, _ []string, source pgx.CopyFromSource) (int64, error) {
	var buffer *any
	for source.Next() {
		values, err := source.Values()
		if err != nil {
			return 0, err
		}
		if buffer != nil && buffer != &values[0] {
			return 0, errors.New("CopyFrom allocated another row buffer")
		}
		buffer = &values[0]
		db.copied = append(db.copied, append([]any(nil), values...))
	}
	return int64(len(db.copied)), source.Err()
}

type fakeBatchResults struct{ pgx.BatchResults }

func (fakeBatchResults) Exec() (pgconn.CommandTag, error) { return pgconn.CommandTag{}, nil }
func (fakeBatchResults) Close() error                     { return nil }
func (db *fakeDB) SendBatch(_ context.Context, batch *pgx.Batch) pgx.BatchResults {
	db.batch = batch
	return fakeBatchResults{}
}

func TestBulkOperationsPreserveEachRowsArguments(t *testing.T) {
	db := &fakeDB{}
	q := New(db)
	count, err := q.CopyUsers(t.Context(), []CopyUsersParams{{ID: 1, Name: "first", Age: 10}, {ID: 2, Name: "second", Age: 20}})
	if err != nil || count != 2 || db.copied[0][0] != int64(1) || db.copied[1][0] != int64(2) {
		t.Fatalf("copy: %v %v", db.copied, err)
	}
	err = q.BatchUsers(t.Context(), []BatchUsersParams{{ID: 1, Name: "first", Age: 10}, {ID: 2, Name: "second", Age: 20}})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if cap(db.batch.QueuedQueries) != 2 || len(db.batch.QueuedQueries) != 2 {
		t.Fatal("batch capacity differs from input")
	}
	if db.batch.QueuedQueries[0].Arguments[0] != int64(1) || db.batch.QueuedQueries[1].Arguments[0] != int64(2) {
		t.Fatal("queued rows share arguments")
	}
}

func TestBuilderResultsSurviveSubsequentBuilds(t *testing.T) {
	builder := New(&fakeDB{}).SearchUsers().Where("age", ">", 20).Limit(5)
	text, args, err := builder.buildQuery()
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	earlierText := text
	earlierArgs := append([]any(nil), args...)
	builder.Where("name", "=", "Alice").Offset(10)
	_, _, err = builder.buildQuery()
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if text != earlierText || !reflect.DeepEqual(args, earlierArgs) {
		t.Fatal("building again changed previous results")
	}
}

func TestOptionalEmbedsAllocateOnlyForPresentRows(t *testing.T) {
	db := &fakeDB{rows: fakeRows{n: 3, data: [][]any{{1, "first", 10, 11, "one", 1}, {2, "second", 20, nil, nil, nil}, {3, "third", 30, 33, "three", 3}}}}
	q := New(db)
	rows, err := q.ListOrderRows(t.Context())
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if rows[0].OrderItems == nil || rows[1].OrderItems != nil || rows[2].OrderItems == nil || *rows[0].OrderItems.ID != 11 || *rows[2].OrderItems.ID != 33 {
		t.Fatalf("optional embed changed: %+v", rows)
	}
	var streamed []StreamOrderRowsRow
	for row, err := range q.StreamOrderRows(t.Context()) {
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		streamed = append(streamed, row)
	}
	if streamed[1].OrderItems != nil || *streamed[0].OrderItems.ID != 11 {
		t.Fatal("streamed embed aliases later storage")
	}
	db.rows.data = [][]any{{int64(1), "first", int32(10), nil, nil, nil}}
	db.rows.n = 1000
	count := testing.AllocsPerRun(20, func() {
		var err error
		optionalRowsSink, err = q.ListOrderRows(context.Background())
		if err != nil {
			panic(err)
		}
	})
	if count > 25 {
		t.Fatalf("absent embeds allocated per row: %.0f allocations", count)
	}
	db.rows.n = 0
	count = testing.AllocsPerRun(20, func() {
		var err error
		optionalRowsSink, err = q.ListOrderRows(context.Background())
		if err != nil {
			panic(err)
		}
	})
	if count != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("empty optional rows allocated scratch: %.0f", count)
	}
}

var optionalRowsSink []ListOrderRowsRow
